subject: SLA & Premium Support — Helios pricing / uptime tiers discussion
messages:
From: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@helioshealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com, itops@helioshealth.com
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial question: uptime tiers and support pricing

Hi Markus / Rishi —

Thanks for the call earlier. Procurement asked me to get a clear written breakdown of the SLA options you offer and the incremental pricing for premium support. Specifically:

- Uptime tiers (99.9 vs 99.95 vs 99.99) and what compensations or credits apply for breaches
- P1/P2 response targets (hours) and on-call coverage (8x5 vs 24x7)
- Escalation path — named contacts, C-level notifications, and War Room availability
- Any discounts available tied to committed spend / contract length

We are evaluating two things: (1) production critical models for our patient-facing workflows (need stronger SLA) and (2) non-critical internal tooling (can live on standard).

Can you send a concise cost table and any appendix we need to feed to legal?

Best,
Ana Ramirez
CFO (acting on procurement)
Helios Health

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@helioshealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial question: uptime tiers and support pricing

Ana —

Appreciate the list. I attached a short appendix that summarizes our SLA tiers and the support packages (redwood-premium-sla-appendix_v2.pdf). Quick highlights below — I kept pricing at a high level so we can iterate: 

- Uptime tiers:
  • Standard (99.9%): included with hosted API. Credits: 5% monthly credit for breaches below target.
  • Enhanced (99.95%): add-on; recommended for low-latency production workloads. Credits: sliding scale up to 10%.
  • Premium (99.99%): for mission-critical customer-facing apps. Includes proactive incident reviews and 24x7 war room. Credits: up to 25% depending on duration.

- Response times / escalation:
  • P1 (System down / service-impacting): 1 hour response, 2-hour remediation target for Premium; 4-hour response for Enhanced; 8-hour for Standard.
  • P2 (Degraded performance): 4 hours response Premium; 8 hours Enhanced; 24 hours Standard.
  • 24x7 phone escalation and named on-call available for Premium customers; Enhanced gets extended business hours + on-call pager.

- Pricing model options:
  • % of committed monthly spend for Premium support (typical 8–15% depending on tier and term).
  • Flat-seat or per-endpoint pricing for War Room / named support is available.
  • We can offer a term discount for 12–36 month commitments; the appendix shows examples.

I copied Monica from Customer Success to confirm operational details and Rishi on commercial terms. If youd like, we can convert the appendix into a one-page SOW and a pricing spreadsheet for procurement.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-premium-sla-appendix_v2.pdf]

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0114

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@helioshealth.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA details and escalation coverage (operational notes)

Hi Ana / team —

A couple of operational clarifications from CS/operations: 

- War Room: For Premium SLA we staff a dedicated incident war room for severity-1 incidents for the first 72 hours. That includes a senior on-call eng, an operations lead, and a customer success manager.
- Named contacts: we can provide up to 3 named escalation contacts (phone + email) and a weekly cadence for proactive reviews during onboarding.
- Audit logs & runbooks: included as part of the Premium onboarding package. We will provide a playbook and an agreed runbook for known failure modes.

If Helios needs a 30-minute standby call at any hour (external facing P1), that can be included in the Premium package (wed price it as part of the named-on-call fee or include it against committed spend).

For procurement: weve found customers prefer a blended approach — Premium on production clusters (99.99) and Enhanced for non-critical clusters. Happy to map this to your environments in a short follow-up.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@helioshealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com, itops@helioshealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA & Premium Support — Helios pricing / uptime tiers discussion

Markus / Rishi —

Thanks for the detail — this helps. A few follow-ups from procurement before we loop legal: 

1) Credits: can you make the credit schedule for Enhanced / Premium concrete (example table with % credit at 1, 3, 6, 12 hour breach durations)? Procurement needs firm numbers to compare to other vendors.
2) P1 response: 1 hour is acceptable for Premium. Can you guarantee a named escalation contact and 30-minute availability window for on-call during remediation for an extra committed fee?
3) Discounts: Helios is prepared to commit to a 24-month minimum for production workloads if you can provide a 20% discount on the Premium support charge and waive onboarding fees. That would cover at least $480k in ARR across the term.

If you can get a revised proposal into a short SOW + pricing spreadsheet today well review and aim to get legal a redline by Monday.

Thanks,
Ana

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Ramirez <ana.ramirez@helioshealth.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA & Premium Support — Helios pricing / uptime tiers discussion

Ana —

Thanks, this is straightforward to action. Attached is a concise SOW + pricing workbook that makes the credit schedule explicit and shows two commercial options: (A) 24-month commit with 20% off Premium support + waived onboarding (we can accept Helioss ask), or (B) 12-month commit with 12% off and a reduced onboarding fee. See SOW-Helios-2026.xlsx and pricing-summary-Helios-2026.csv.

Highlights / confirmations:
- Premium SLA: 99.99% uptime, 1 hour P1 response, 2-hour remediation target for production clusters; War Room staffed 24x7 for first 72 hours of an incident.
- Credit schedule: Premium breaches: 1 hour -> 5% credit, 3 hours -> 12% credit, 6 hours -> 18% credit, >12 hours -> 25% credit. Enhanced uses a scaled-down schedule (in spreadsheet).
- Named escalation: yes — well provide up to 3 named escalation contacts and confirm 30-minute standby window for P1 remediation as an addendum (included under Option A).
- Commercial: Option A (24mo / 20% off Premium support) requires signature on the attached SOW; we can draft the DocuSign link once you confirm.

Next step: if you confirm Option A, I will convert the SOW to a DocuSign envelope and share the link for signature. Happy to join a short call if procurement wants to walk through the two options.

Attachments: [attachment: SOW-Helios-2026.xlsx] [attachment: pricing-summary-Helios-2026.csv]

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
